thread:
Elaine: Quick design check — added a compact 'Rollback' microflow to the timeline in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frame: Compact-Rollback-Flow)
Sam: Nice. My first thought: the inline 'Undo' is too subtle on mobile. Maybe a floating snackbar? :thinking:
Marius: Agree with Sam. Snackbars get missed if the timeline scrolls. Also need keyboard focus to go to the Undo button after action.
Aisha: Accessibility note — the rollback confirmation dialog uses 'Rollback to v3.7' as heading. Prefer 'Revert to model version v3.7 (snapshot: 2025-03-07)' for more context.
Noah: We should avoid 'Rollback' verb for users who might not understand. Consider 'Revert' or 'Switch to previous version' — we can A/B test wording later.
Elaine: Good points. Two options in prototype: inline compact undo + ephemeral toast, or modal with stronger wording. Thoughts on which to default to?
Sam: Modal for destructive flows, toast for non-destructive. This feels destructive (traffic shift), so modal.
Marius: Modal also allows explicit radio choices: 'Disable canary' vs 'Revert fully' which helps reduce accidental full rollbacks.
Aisha: ARIA: current confirm button has aria-label="rollback" which is too generic. Use aria-labelledby + aria-describedby pointing to heading and reason text. Example:

```html
<button aria-labelledby="rollback-title" aria-describedby="rollback-desc">Revert</button>
```

Elaine: Great, can we also make the timeline entries keyboard-collapsible? When there are many versions the compact view should show grouped actor badges and expand on Enter.
Noah: UX nit: show who initiated the rollout (team/person) inline — clickable for audit logs.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Past rollback event: rollback started by Sam at 2025-03-11T16:22Z — link: https://deploys.company/rollbacks/1234 :information_source:
Sam: Another copy nit: confirmation sentence currently 'This will rollback production.' change to 'This will revert production traffic to version v3.7. This action can be undone within 2 minutes.'
Aisha: Make the 'undo window' machine-readable in UI for screen readers: 'You can undo within 2 minutes' -> include timer aria-live region updating seconds left.
Elaine: For A/B tests, we need to surface active variants and which cohort is affected. Maybe small pill tags 'A: v3.7 (10%), B: v3.8 (90%)' with hover details.
Marius: Performance: avoid animating full timeline collapse — prefer height transitions and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
Noah: I'll mock updated copy in the Figma file and add aria snippets.
Elaine: Thanks all — I'll update prototypes and escalate modal as default for rollbacks. Filing follow-up with PM @Sam for A/B labelling. :thumbsup:
Sam: ack. I'll loop in Eng to check if 'undo window' can be implemented server-side.
aria-a11y: Quick checklist — focus trap in modal, aria-live for toast, descriptive aria-labels for timeline items, color contrast >= 4.5:1 for danger states. Will review after update.
Elaine: Will ping again when updated frames are ready.
